EMS-CTRL-029.name: Performance Testing
EMS-CTRL-029.evidence_authority: Approved service-performance evidence store referenced by the EMS service registry; repository evidence is supporting only.

assertions.ems_requirement: Apply to production services at initial production release and after a material change to workload, capacity, data access, interface, or scaling behavior.
Require an approved service-specific workload profile representing expected use and relevant peak or failure behavior.
Require service-specific approved performance objectives/baselines in the service registry or linked controlled evidence; no universal numeric threshold is established by this control.
Use an approved service-performance evidence store referenced by the EMS service registry, containing environment, workload profile, revision, results, timestamp, and validating actor/workflow.

PASS only when authoritative service evidence proves the approved service-specific objective; FAIL only when authoritative evidence proves violation; missing/inaccessible/ambiguous evidence routes to HUMAN_REVIEW.
Use a time-bounded service exception with objective gap, risk, compensating controls, service owner, operational approver, expiry, and remediation plan.

EMS-CTRL-027.name: Regression Testing
EMS-CTRL-027.evidence_authority: Approved CI/CD execution evidence bound to the repository and revision; controlled exception evidence where applicable.

assertions.ems_requirement: Require regression testing for changes classified in a controlled test-impact assessment as affecting supported behavior; documentation-only changes are excluded.
Require CI/CD execution record with repository, revision, selected regression suite, result, timestamp, and workflow identity.
A failed required regression test blocks change acceptance or release unless an approved exception is active.
Permit a time-bounded exception with affected change, risk rationale, compensating controls, accountable owner, approving authority, expiry, and remediation plan.

EMS-CTRL-028.name: Contract/API Testing
EMS-CTRL-028.evidence_authority: Approved CI/CD contract/API execution evidence bound to repository, revision, interface/version, result, timestamp, and workflow identity.

assertions.ems_requirement: Apply when a repository publishes, consumes, or changes a versioned API, event schema, or external integration interface.
Require positive, negative/error, and compatibility/breaking-change coverage for each applicable changed interface.
Require CI/CD execution evidence bound to repository, revision, interface/version, test result, timestamp, and workflow identity.
A failed required contract/API test blocks change acceptance or release unless an approved exception is active.
Require a compatibility-deprecation record with consumer notification, migration window, owner, approval, expiry, and rollback plan.

EMS-CTRL-031.name: Test Evidence Retention
EMS-CTRL-031.evidence_authority: Approved controlled CI/CD artifact store or evidence repository with access control, retention configuration, and tamper-evident or immutable retention capability; repository artifact presence alone is supporting evidence only.

assertions.ems_requirement: Retain required test execution result, revision/build identifier, test configuration or suite identity, relevant logs/reports, and approval/exception record where applicable.
Retain required test evidence for three years.
Use an approved controlled CI/CD artifact store or evidence repository with access control, retention configuration, and tamper-evident or immutable retention capability.
Bind retained evidence to repository, source revision, build or workflow run, test suite, result, timestamp, and related change/release when applicable.
Legal, regulatory, contractual, audit, or active-investigation holds override deletion; other deviations require a time-bounded controlled exception.

PASS only when authoritative store configuration and required retained evidence satisfy policy; FAIL when authoritative evidence proves early deletion or insufficient configured retention; inaccessible or ambiguous authority routes to HUMAN_REVIEW.
